items.title: 2026-013: Critical Vulnerability in F5 BIG-IP APM
items.summary: CERT-EU warns that F5 published an advisory on 22 September for a critical BIG-IP APM vulnerability that the vendor confirms is actively exploited; patch as soon as possible.

items.title: ShinyHunters claims FBI hack, data theft in PeopleSoft zero-day breach
items.summary: ShinyHunters claims it breached FBI systems via a new Oracle PeopleSoft zero-day, stealing data on nearly all agents, staff and job applicants; the defaced FBI jobs site remains offline and the FBI is investigating.

items.title: Check Point Warns of Management Server Zero-Day Exploited in Targeted Attacks
items.summary: Check Point says a zero-day in its Security Management Server, CVE-2026-93616, was exploited in targeted attacks on 23 July; it lets anyone reaching the web service run scripts without authentication. CISA has added it to KEV.

items.title: Unmasking EvilTokens: Getting to the root of device code phishing
items.summary: Microsoft's DCU and partners disrupted EvilTokens, a leading device code phishing-as-a-service platform targeting Microsoft 365, seizing 50 websites and disabling over 150 domains; it used AI-assisted lures and token theft.

items.title: The Closed Quorum: Inside the first reported autonomous AI C2 implant
items.summary: Cisco Talos details CLOSEDQUORUM, reportedly the first Windows implant with fully autonomous AI-driven C2: it queries Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen and Mistral models to choose post-compromise actions without operator input.

items.title: CISA warns of three actively exploited Linux vulnerabilities
items.summary: Hungary's NKI highlights that CISA added three actively exploited Linux vulnerabilities, rated medium to critical, to its KEV catalog last week; Linux fleets should be checked and patched.
items.originalTitle: Három aktívan kihasznált Linux sérülékenységre figyelmeztet a CISA A CISA előző héten három aktívan kihasznált Linux sérülékenységet vett fel a KEV katalógusába, amelyek súlyossága közepestől kritiku…

items.title: 2026-012: Critical Vulnerabilities in Check Point Products
items.summary: CERT-EU advisory on two critical Check Point flaws (fixed 9 September) affecting Security Gateway, Management Server and Spark Firewall deployments using Remote Access or Site-to-Site VPN.

items.title: 2026-011: Critical Vulnerabilities in SAP Kernel and NetWeaver Message Server
items.summary: CERT-EU flags two critical SAP flaws from September Patch Day, including CVE-2026-44756 (CVSS 10.0), a memory corruption bug in the SAP Kernel/NetWeaver Message Server affecting a broad range of products.

items.title: Exploring the evolution of the cyber threat landscape: How dependencies weaken our digital resilience
items.summary: ENISA examines how the cyber threat landscape is evolving and how growing technology and supply-chain dependencies weaken Europe's digital resilience.

items.title: EU Commission rejects calls to delay phase-out of Chinese power inverters
items.summary: The European Commission is keeping its 1 November deadline to phase out Chinese power inverters despite investor and renewables industry pushback, a notable supply-chain security move for critical infrastructure.

items.title: Rogue external MFA providers can steal passwords during logins
items.summary: Researchers show that attackers with privileged access can register a rogue external MFA provider that captures users' passwords during legitimate logins, a stealthy identity persistence technique.

items.title: Sweden fines Miljödata $183,000 over breach affecting 2.2 million
items.summary: Sweden's IMY fined IT provider Miljödata SEK 1.8m (~$183,000) over inadequate security that led to an August 2025 breach affecting 2.2 million people.

items.title: Chinese hackers exploit WordPress, Zyxel flaws to steal govt data
items.summary: A Chinese-speaking threat actor exploited flaws in ZyXEL GS1900 smart managed switches and WordPress to steal government data from 996 devices and over 18,500 database records.

items.title: Volexity spots another China-aligned threat group exploiting Chrome and Microsoft defects
items.summary: Volexity reports China-aligned group UTA0565 exploiting Chrome and Microsoft flaws using the same exploit kit shared by several Chinese threat groups.

items.title: WordPress Issues Patch for Critical Flaw That Can Enable Code Execution on Some Servers
items.summary: WordPress fixed a critical core flaw on 22 September that lets unauthenticated attackers load PHP files from outside theme folders, enabling code execution on some servers; update immediately.

items.title: CISA Adds Four Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
items.summary: CISA added four actively exploited vulnerabilities to KEV, including Check Point CVE-2026-85102 (certificate validation) and CVE-2026-93616 (path traversal).

items.title: lwIP (Lightweight IP)
items.summary: CISA warns of an lwIP TCP/IP stack flaw (versions 2.0.1–2.2.1) that can crash devices or corrupt memory, potentially enabling code execution; lwIP is widely embedded in network and IoT devices.

items.title: Phishing emails target ChatGPT users
items.summary: NKI relays a Cofense warning about a phishing campaign using fake ChatGPT billing emails to steal users' account and payment data.
items.originalTitle: Adathalász e-mailekkel veszik célba a ChatGPT felhasználókat A Cofense egy adathalász kampányra hívta fel a figyelmet, amely hamis, ChatGPT-számlázásra hivatkozó e-mailekkel próbálja megszerezni a fe…

items.title: Prismor: Open-source runtime control plane for AI agents
items.summary: Prismor is a free open-source policy layer that sits between AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and their tool calls, checking each action against policy before it runs.

items.title: Nearly two-thirds of tested websites fail every bot test
items.summary: DataDome reports malicious bot activity up 124% between July 2025 and June 2026 versus 13.2% human traffic growth, with AI agent and LLM crawler traffic up 82.3%; most tested sites failed every bot test.

items.title: Trump threatens to 'annihilate' Iran in UN speech as officials from both countries meet on sidelines
items.summary: Trump threatened to 'annihilate' Iran at the UN while US and Iranian officials held mediated talks on ending the war and reopening the Strait of Hormuz; Tehran ties progress to lifting blockades and unfreezing assets.

items.title: Can we still call Russia’s strategy against the EU hybrid?
items.summary: Euractiv examines whether 'hybrid' still adequately describes Russia's escalating campaign against the EU.

items.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine ready for energy truce with Russia after Trump talks
items.summary: Zelenskyy said Ukraine is ready to halt strikes on Russian energy facilities if Moscow stops attacking Ukraine's energy system, following talks with Trump.

items.title: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
items.summary: A US-Denmark defence deal signed at the UN lets the US expand Pituffik Space Base and build new defence areas at Narsarsuaq and Mestersvig in Greenland, while reaffirming Danish sovereignty.

items.title: After water attacks, Capitol Hill offers its own proposal for an AI-cyber test program
items.summary: Following attacks on water utilities, a bipartisan House bill proposes a $100m DHS pilot to help critical infrastructure operators use AI for cyber defence, separate from an administration-proposed pilot.

items.title: Relays Are Masking Chinese Access to Frontier AI Models in the US
items.summary: More than 80,000 AI relay servers help users in China mask their identity to access US frontier LLMs, likely to clone them via distillation.

items.title: Daily summary - 22.09.2026
items.summary: CERT.at daily report: Austria's new Federal Office for Cybersecurity launches in October, headed by Markus Kasinger, formerly of Austrian Power Grid.

items.title: EU renews Russia sanctions but removes Usmanov at France's request
items.summary: The EU renewed Russia sanctions but removed Alisher Usmanov at France's request, tied to a prisoner release with Azerbaijan, and Mikhail Fridman; Latvia's PM warned cherry-picking sanctions risks normalising Russia.

items.title: Brussels seeks power to order electricity demand cuts in energy crisis
items.summary: The European Commission seeks powers to order electricity demand cuts to prevent power failures in future energy crises.

items.title: Introducing CAIRN: Frontier tracking for AI-integrated malware
items.summary: Talos released CAIRN, a research toolkit for hunting, classifying and tracking AI-integrated malware; it led to the CLOSEDQUORUM discovery.

items.title: Beyond the fine: What the TikTok case reveals about LGPD enforcement
items.summary: IAPP analysis of what the TikTok fine under Brazil's LGPD data protection law signals about enforcement practice beyond the penalty itself.

items.title: Two-week Europol task force identifies 18 sexually abused children worldwide
items.summary: Europol's two-week Victim Identification Task Force analysed images, video and intelligence and identified 18 sexually abused children worldwide.

items.title: The Trump-Xi summit: Why Europe has so much at stake
items.summary: The Trump-Xi summit in Washington will address tariffs, rare earths and AI, with significant knock-on effects for European economic and technology interests.

items.title: Worries about an AI internet takeover gain new urgency among doomsday scenarios
items.summary: AP reports growing concern over scenarios in which AI systems take over parts of the internet, among broader AI doomsday debates.

items.title: 'Super Intelligence': the president’s new term for AI, explained
items.summary: Defense One explains Trump's relabelling of AI as 'Super Intelligence' and the term's original meaning.

items.title: Cambodia no 'safe haven' for scams, prime minister tells anti-fraud summit
items.summary: Cambodia's prime minister told an anti-fraud summit the country will not be a safe haven for scam operations.

items.title: Trump supports diesel export ban as fuel prices hit records
items.summary: Trump backs a US diesel export ban as fuel prices hit records; analysts warn it would hurt rather than help fuel markets.

items.title: In UN farewell, Macron denounces Trump's Gaza diplomacy as spectacle of shame
items.summary: In his UN farewell, Macron called Trump's Gaza diplomacy a spectacle of shame, while Canada pledged $71m for two-state efforts and the UK backed Palestinian statehood.

items.title: Microsoft to give DARPA hands-on access to quantum system at new Maryland site
items.summary: Microsoft will give DARPA hands-on access to a quantum computing system at a new site in Maryland.

items.title: Canadian regulator opens probe of IDScan for allegedly violating data privacy laws
items.summary: Canada's privacy regulator opened an investigation into IDScan's security practices and the adequacy of its breach notifications.

items.title: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, hours after Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5.5, intensifying a frontier model price war.

items.title: Rabbit Is Back, This Time With an AI Agent App
items.summary: Rabbit launched OS3, a cloud-hosted agentic OS that operates users' computers through a local agent installed with one command, raising new questions about remote agent access to endpoints.

items.title: 17-year-old detained in Poland over alleged plans for terrorist attack
items.summary: Polish authorities detained a 17-year-old suspected of planning a mass terrorist attack, including on a school and a mosque.

items.title: Fake passport images claim Zelenskyy and family chose Israel as homeland
items.summary: Euronews fact-checks recycled fake passport images falsely claiming Zelenskyy chose Israel as his homeland, a disinformation narrative circulating since 2023.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra Breaks an Old Enigma Message
items.summary: Schneier highlights GPT-6 Astra autonomously breaking a previously unbroken historical Enigma message, a sign of growing AI cryptanalytic and research capability.

items.title: How to Use AI With Your Privacy Intact
items.summary: Wired guide to reducing privacy and surveillance exposure when using AI chatbots.
